Debian security tracker, trixie and trixie-security openssl 3.5.7-1~deb13u3: vulnerable, no fixed version. Use after free when an application passes an existing stack to PEM_X509_INFO_read_bio_ex() and keeps using it after a failed read; OpenSSL itself never does this. From the distroless base image, which ships libssl3t64 3.5.7-1~deb13u3; nothing in the image loads the system libssl or libcrypto: a DT_NEEDED scan of every ELF in the pinned amd64 image (285 files, layers fetched by digest) finds libcrypto.so.3 only in libssl3t64's own libssl.so.3 and engines-3, node links neither (it bundles OpenSSL 3.5.9), and the API's production node_modules hold no ELF file. The API reads no PEM certificate bundle.
